description: One of the caller's own listings on XP, seen as the seller -- 'any new offers on my tickets?'. Returns the state, seats, disclosures, visible_to_buyers and the open offers on it, with amounts in dollars (amount_usd). visible_to_buyers, not the state, says whether buyers can see the listing. When is_seller is true, each open offer carries actions for accept_offer and reject_offer. When the listing has sold and awaits the seller's transfer, the result carries the transfer instructions and the remaining obligation. identifier comes from create_listing, list_my_listings or list_open_listings. Requires sign-in and the read:bids scope.

identifier.description: Public listing identifier from create_listing (listing_identifier), list_open_listings or list_my_listings.
